body:
> Given its name I think it is a stress test.

This doesn't look like it's _measuring_ performance per se. "Stress test" can also mean it's testing the system under "extreme load", acting as a unit test.

Still, this test isn't doing that either: Rather, it's a random selection test. There is poor evidence for random selection tests being worthwhile, mostly because it's practically performing the same kind of test thousands of times, rather than testing actually interesting cases[^1]. All in all, I fully agree with you: I don't think this test is an appropriate expenditure of time. It isn't as bad for me as it is for you, but I benchmarked it to take ~1.6s (13%) on my machine.

Unfortunately I can't add my approval, because this definitely needs a look over from someone familiar with the code. We don't want to accidentally leave open regression holes. 

[^1]: Sorry, I don't have a convenient source for this. If someone's interested I can try to dig up my old university texts for this claim 😅
